label: preparing
what: A surprise committee feast/supper for the mayor, planned for tomorrow at 18:00 in the great hall: 200 loaves and eight lanterns, while keeping the purpose hidden from the mayor until then. Baker knowingly helped supply the bread (ultimately 56 loaves on credit); builder installed lanterns and arranged the mayor's supposed inspection; freight coordinated bread and intended to escort him. The mayor was told it was a lighting inspection, not the surprise.
